messages:
evan: Noticing some revoke flows attributed to org-owner instead of the SA project after yesterday's routing tweak. Saw it on Billing spikes.

kim: Acked. I traced a couple traces where auth-proxy normalizes headers and drops X-Project when using the short-lived exchange.

rachel: Repro: Console -> Roles -> Revoke -> confirm. Intermittent. If the exchange goes through proxy the origin_project claim is gone.

evan: Sampling change made the pattern pop up in dashboards. Two problems: telemetry attribution and actual quota/billing routing.

kim: Short-term mitigation: API fallback that checks authn-cache for last effective project for token id. Medium: console attach signed X-Origin-Project header. Long: bind project into token claim (token_v2).

infra-bot: action: INC-1791-created (P2) 1 assigned to eng-platform oncall.

rachel: Can we also add a metric auth_attrib_fallback_total and a Grafana panel showing token|fallback|proxy split? Support wants visibility.

evan: Yes. Alert if fallback rate > 0.25% of revoke traffic.

ui-bot: UX suggestion: add a one-liner in the revoke modal: "Revoking as: service-account X (project Y) 1 charges billed to project Y". Low friction.

kim: I'll send a tiny console PR to attach signed header and the revoke text. Evan will do the API fallback canary. Rachel can own the metrics + dashboard.

evan: Plan: canary API fallback first, deploy console header in parallel, backfill telemetry for last 48h once fallback is live. Monitoring on the board.

rachel: Filed the dashboard mock and alert thresholds. Linking PRs in the incident.

evan: Thanks. Will post canary status here and escalate if fallback spikes. :thumbsup:
